driveDate: 2026-09-13 (Sunday, live clock, both apps, same session)

method.todoist: created disposable 'ZZ probe P1'..'ZZ probe P4' via Quick Add typing 'ZZ probe P1' etc, letting Quick Add's own NLP recognize the 'P1'..'P4' token as priority (confirmed: after recognition the Task name field shows the priority chip separately, and after submit the stored title is the bare 'ZZ probe' with the priority attribute set -- verified by re-reading the created titles, which read 'ZZ probe' not 'ZZ probe P1'). Two at a time (P1+P2, then P3+P4), measured, then deleted, per the two-at-a-time safety cap. Ring read from getComputedStyle(...).border on the checkbox's own visible inner <span> (the one with a non-transparent border), identified by button.task_checkbox's own priority_N class.
method.meologue: seeded through taskStore.upsert() with stored priority 4/3/2/1 for UI P1/P2/P3/P4 (the type's own documented inversion), content literally 'ZZ probe P1'..'ZZ probe P4' (meologue renders a text priority badge so the literal text is retained, unlike Todoist which strips the recognized token). Ring read via getComputedStyle on the row's <input type=checkbox>'s own box-shadow.

todoist.source: Quick Add's own 'Set priority' popup, read live via getComputedStyle on the option's svg path (fill=currentColor), closed with Escape without changing the NLP-set value

meologue.source: corpus values from live-audit-dom/flow2-ROW-03-PRI-05-06-PRI-03-meologue.json (--td-priority-picker-* CSS custom properties), not re-driven this round because the priority picker's own reachability was unchanged by this fix phase

verdict.ROW-03_ring_width: MATCH on both apps now: 2px for P1/P2/P3, 1px for P4 (the true no-priority default), in both Todoist and meologue. meologue previously rendered P2/P3 at 1px; that is fixed.
verdict.PRI-05_row_vs_picker: MATCH -- in meologue, row ring colours (P1 rgb(255,112,102), P2 rgb(255,154,19), P3 rgb(82,151,255), P4 rgb(169,169,169)) are now each distinct from their own picker swatch colours (P1 rgb(209,69,59), P2 rgb(235,137,9), P3 rgb(36,111,224), P4 rgb(102,102,102)) at every priority level, matching Todoist's own 'two surfaces, two values' rule at every level, not only P1. Before this fix, meologue's P2/P3 row colours equalled their own picker colours; that unification is gone.
verdict.PRI-06_p2_p3: MATCH -- P2 now reads 2px rgb(255,154,19) and P3 2px rgb(82,151,255) in meologue, identical to Todoist.
verdict.checkboxRingColour_and_width: MATCH across all four priorities on both axes (width and colour).
